messages:
Sam (Support): FYI - customer on Dedicated (tenant: kiteworks) reports tool call failures from our SDKs. Tool `ingest_document` returns 400 schema validation: \"field pages: expected array, got string\". Happens from Python, TS, and Go clients. Repro below.

Sam (Support): Python minimal repro (using python-sdk v0.9.2):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"REDACTED\")
pages = [{\"text\": \"hello\"}]
payload = {\"tool\": \"ingest_document\", \"args\": {\"pages\": pages}}
client.call_tool(payload)
```
Outgoing request body we captured from the customer's logs (note `pages` is a JSON string):
```json
{
  \"tool\": \"ingest_document\",
  \"args\": {
    \"pages\": \"[{\\\"text\\\": \\\"hello\\\"}]\"
  }
}
```

Morgan (DevEx): Thanks Sam. Can you paste the request headers and SDK versions? Is this only when pages is an array of objects or any nested structure?

Sam (Support): Headers show python-sdk/0.9.2, node-sdk/0.8.7, go-sdk/0.3.4. It repros with arrays of objects and nested dicts; flat primitives are fine. Customer said they didn't change their code but upgraded the SDK last week.

Ben (Prod): That captured body looks like double-serialization of the `args` value (object => string). Do we have a recent change that stringifies nested args for backwards compatibility?

Lina (Eng): I think I see the pattern. We added a safety encoder that calls `json.dumps`/`JSON.stringify` on values marked as \"raw\" to avoid binary issues, but a bug causes it to run on any non-primitive (arrays/objects) when an internal flag is set. So arrays end up turned into strings. Working theory: marshaller sees `pages` typed as \"any\" and applies fallback encoder.

Morgan (DevEx): Can we get a TS repro? Customer also provided one.

Sam (Support): TS repro (node-sdk v0.8.7):
```javascript
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const pages = [{ text: 'hello' }]
await client.callTool('ingest_document', { pages })
```
Captured outgoing body (node):
```json
{
  \"tool\": \"ingest_document\",
  \"args\": {
    \"pages\": \"[{\\\"text\\\":\\\"hello\\\"}]\"
  }
}
```

Ben (Prod): Good repro. Can someone grep for \"safety encoder\" or recent marshaller changes? Pin suspects: commit 9c3a7f7 (marshalling refactor) and the TS port in PR #4281.

Lina (Eng): Confirmed. The refactor introduced a code path that treats non-primitive nested values as \"opaque\" and encodes them as strings. We should revert that part and add unit tests for nested arrays/objects in tool args. I'll open a hotfix PR now (target: patch release).

Lina (Eng): Short-term workarounds for customers:
- Call the REST API directly with a correctly typed JSON body (bypasses SDK marshaller). Example curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/call \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\"tool\":\"ingest_document\",\"args\":{\"pages\":[{\"text\":\"hello\"}]}}'
```
- Pin to previous SDK versions (python 0.9.1, node 0.8.6, go 0.3.3) until patch.
- As a temporary proxy fix, add a middleware that JSON-parses any arg that is a string but looks like JSON (i.e., starts with `[{` or `\{\"`). Not ideal, but worked for one customer.

Morgan (DevEx): ETA on patch? Need to tell customer SLA/ETA.

Lina (Eng): Hotfix opened: PR #4312. Plan: revert the opaque-encoding path and add tests for nested arrays/objects and bytes handling. Target releases: python 0.9.3, node 0.8.8, go 0.3.5. Rolling patch for hosted endpoints to accept stringified args as fallback is also being applied. ETA: patch merge in ~3 hours, staged rollouts over the next 2 hours after verification.

deploy-bot: rolled back hosted marshaller to stable snapshot (vstable-2026-11-18) at 1785001280.

Sam (Support): Applied the REST workaround for kiteworks and they confirmed ingestion resumed. Please keep me posted on the release so I can advise other impacted customers. :thumbsup:

Lina (Eng): I'll post the PR and release notes here when ready.

Ben (Prod): Add a regression test to the QA harness covering nested tool args and include Python/TS/Go matrix.

Sam (Support): Thanks team — logging follow-up with the customer now.
